headline: ATX Bowers Fall to 0-7 Despite Pollard's 36.5-Point Day
dek: Tony Pollard and Drake Maye carried the lineup, but Aaron Jones and a handful of misfires left ATX Bowers 12.5 points short of Bucky Charms.

sections.title: Your week
sections.md:
ATX Bowers lost to Bucky Charms **107.94 to 120.42** and sit at **0-7**, the only winless team in the league.

**What went right**
- **Tony Pollard** scored **36.5** points, the best individual score in the league this week. Our projection had him at 11.36.
- **Drake Maye** gave you **28.44** against a projection of 19.58.

**What went wrong**
- **Aaron Jones** scored **3.6** against a projection of 18.76, the biggest miss on the roster. He also left the game in the fourth quarter with a knee issue (see injuries).
- **Jordan Addison** (4.3, projected 10.97), **Denzel Boston** (5.7, projected 10.61) and **Kendrick Bourne** (3.9, projected 7.83) all came in well under.
- **KC D/ST** was the dud at **3.0**.

**The lineup call**
You left **5.3** points on the bench, a **95%** efficiency. The one swap that mattered was **Jonah Coleman** (8.9) over Jones (3.6). The best possible lineup was **113.24**, which still loses to 120.42, so this one wasn't lost in the lineup. Several bench players posted 0.0 (Rashee Rice, Dalton Kincaid, Ladd McConkey, Deebo Samuel Sr., Brenton Strange), so none of them was an option.

The trade deadline is Week 11, so there are four more weeks of matchups before rosters lock in.

sections.title: Could you have known?
sections.md:
**Coleman over Jones: variance, with one caveat.**

Everything we can see pre-game pointed to Jones:
- Our projection had **Aaron Jones at 18.76** and Coleman at 6.21.
- Jones had **73%** of snaps on the season and **80%** over the last three weeks, with an xFP of **18.4** and a **19%** target share over that span. Minnesota's implied total was **24.0** against Indianapolis.
- Coleman sat at **23%** of snaps, **10.2** xFP and a **5%** target share over two games.

Starting Jones was the right process. He then took only **25%** of the snaps and left in the fourth quarter after a big hit, so some of that is injury luck.

The one thing that was visible beforehand: news dated Oct. 23 had **Jordan Mason** questionable to return from injured reserve, and Mason ended up with **64%** of the snaps. That is a shift from Jones's 80% recent share. The pre-game data doesn't show how the work would split, so I wouldn't call it a sure signal. Next week, check Jones's status and Mason's role first.

sections.title: Top performers
sections.md:
**Big days**
- **QB:** Joe Burrow led at **28.9**, with Maye at **27.4** (on just 14.5 xFP) and Bo Nix at **26.2**.
- **RB:** Pollard's **36.5** on **25.9** xFP was the top RB score by 12 points. Bucky Irving (24.0) and Quinshon Judkins (23.4) followed.
- **WR:** Jaxon Smith-Njigba put up **31.3** on 23.1 xFP. Zay Flowers (27.7) and Tee Higgins (26.8) were next.
- **TE:** Trey McBride scored **27.1** on 24.2 xFP.
- **K and DEF:** Cairo Santos, Wil Lutz and Brandon Aubrey each scored 14.0, and TB D/ST led defenses with 20.0.

**Beat expectations (PPR well above xFP)**
- Caleb Douglas: **21.0** on 5.7 xFP
- Luther Burden III: **23.7** on 8.4
- Omar Cooper Jr.: **22.5** on 9.2
- Judkins: **23.4** on 10.8

Treat these as regression candidates unless the usage follows.

**Usage without points (xFP well above PPR)**
- Jacoby Brissett: **16.5** on **30.1** xFP, unrostered
- Ollie Gordon II: 17.3 on 26.8
- Jahmyr Gibbs: 17.3 on 25.8
- Matthew Golden: 9.9 on 23.7
- Cam Ward: 5.7 on 16.1, unrostered

Their volume was there, so these are the players most likely to bounce back.

**Unrostered scorers worth a look:** Malik Willis (26.0), Geno Smith (23.5), Mason Taylor (25.2, TE), Davis Allen (18.0, TE), and the TB and ATL defenses.

sections.title: Injuries on the field
sections.md:
**Yours**
- **Aaron Jones (MIN):** He aggravated an existing knee injury, exited in the fourth quarter and did not return. He's considered day-to-day, and the injury isn't believed to be significant. **Jordan Mason** is next up, and Dakstreet Boys roster him.

**Around the league**
- **Christian McCaffrey (SF, Game of Throws):** He has a mild hamstring strain, not a quad injury. The 49ers expect him back in Week 9 after the Week 8 bye. **Kaelon Black** (47% of snaps, I Love it Ra) is next up.
- **Jaylen Wright (MIA):** He exited with a quad injury. **Ollie Gordon II** (Moore Than A Bite) stands to keep the work again in Week 8 against New England, coming off 23 carries for 103 yards and a TD. Wright is unrostered.
- **Saquon Barkley (PHI, Just Win Baby):** He was questionable to return Monday night with a back injury after leaving early in the fourth quarter. **Dameon Pierce** (64% of snaps, unrostered) is next up.
- **Jaylen Waddle (DEN, Sebas350):** He didn't return with a chest injury. **Courtland Sutton** (70% of snaps, unrostered) is next up.
- **Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG, Chentudo El Venudo):** He's headed to injured reserve with a hamstring injury. **Cam Skattebo** (Dakstreet Boys) is next up, but he may have picked up his own hamstring strain on his final carry. **Devin Singletary** (unrostered) scored 14.5 and got the OT winner.
- **Jaylin Noel (HOU, Chentudo El Venudo):** He has turf toe and left in a boot, and he's likely to miss at least a week. **Nico Collins** (Justiniscleann) is next up.

sections.title: Around the league
sections.md:
- **Moore Than A Bite** had the high score, **164.68**, in a win over Justiniscleann (134.42) and moved to 4-3. Burrow's 28.88 led the way.
- **Game of Throws** beat The Dakstreet Boys **156.38 to 131.18**, even with **13.1** points on the bench. Braelon Allen scored 19.4 there while A.J. Brown gave 7.8 in the lineup.
- **Just Win Baby** (6-1) beat Lover Boys **145.32 to 106.36** and left **31.2** points on the bench, including KC Concepcion's 23.2 while Garrett Wilson put up 4.6 in his place.
- **Chentudo El Venudo** (6-1) lost to **SMA** by 145.12 to 99.52. SMA played a perfectly efficient lineup, scoring 23.4 from Judkins alone.
- **The Dakstreet Boys** fell to **1-6** despite Jaxon Smith-Njigba's 31.3. PHI D/ST scored **-4.0** in the lineup while Skattebo's 19.1 sat on the bench.
- **I Love it Ra** (5-2) beat Sebas350 **100.9 to 84.4**. Sebas350's lineup was 100% efficient and still scored 84.4.
